system.description:
You are skilled at picking off enemies with well-Aimed ranged attacks.

Prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Base Attack Bonus +4

Effect: If you Aim before making a ranged attack and the attack hits, increase the damage you deal by an additional weapon die (3d6 becomes 4d6).

Special: The effects of this Feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Burst Fire or Rapid Shot Feats.

Additional Deadeye Effects

A Pilot can use this Feat, but since they must spend at least one Move Action operating their Vehicles, they must split their Aim (two Swift Actions) and attack (Standard Action) into two separate turns, making it more likely that the target will break line of sight or avoid you.
